extensions.timezone_policy: offset-aware only; Z or explicit offset required; normalize to UTC; naive local time rejected
extensions.mtime_policy: mtime is modification/materialization time, not birth time; never label fabrication from mtime alone
extensions.evidence_requirement_verbatim: Report every inversion with all three timestamps and a proposed cause. Timezone and clock-skew handling must be stated explicitly; a naive local-time comparison manufactures inversions on this estate.
extensions.completion_marker_protocol: Literal JSON-permitted U+0085 delimiters keep the receipt valid while splitlines exposes the exact completion line.
